name: PLS DONATE 💸
desc:
💸 PLS DONATE is a game where you can raise Robux or donate Robux to others!

How to Play:
🎪 Claim a booth
📝 Customize your booth text
💰 Receive Robux from other players!
💸 Donate Robux to other players!

⚠️ Notes:
• Roblox Plus subscription is required to donate Robux.
• Robux transfers are limited to 500/day and 1,000/month. Turn on 2-Step Verification to increase your limit by 10x.
• If you're under 18, donations may require parental approval and you may need to rejoin the server.
• Due to Roblox's buggy API, transfers may not process unless you rejoin the server.

scripts.title: Auto Beg
scripts.features:
This is a simple script that goes to random people saying phrases that you choose. 


mostDonated = If set to true, the script will walk to people who are over the minimum donated amount that you set in minimumDonated. If set to false it will walk to random people. [true/false]
minimumDonated = Only used if mostDonated is set to true. This is the minimum amount of donated Robux that your target has donated. For example if I set minimumDonated to 500 then it will walk to only others who have donated over 500+ Robux.
cooldown = Cooldown until you walk to another person.

This doesn't loop btw, make sure you dont interact to avoid bugs
Make sure you claim a stand or buy a Donation Sign so people can donate to you
You can edit and add how many messages you want

Made by me \ dank#6969 \ ban#1337
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local cooldown = 10
local minimumDonated = 5000
local mostDonated = false

--//Messages\\

local msgs = {
    "give me your robux",
    "Can you donate to me?",
    "placeholder",
    "placeholder",
}
--//Script\\
if mostDonated == true then
    for i, v in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        if v.Name ~= lp.Name and v.leaderstats:WaitForChild("Donated").Value > minimumDonated then
            lp.Character.Humanoid:MoveTo(v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            wait(4)
            game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(
                msgs[math.random(1, #msgs)],
                "All"
            )
            wait(cooldown)
        end
    end
elseif mostDonated == false then
    for i, v in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
        if v.Name ~= lp.Name then
            lp.Character.Humanoid:MoveTo(v.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            wait(4)
            game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(
                msgs[math.random(1, #msgs)],
                "All"
            )
            wait(cooldown)
        end
    end
end
